title: Using OpenEngine to continuously discover security vulnerabilities
content_md:
We built OpenEngine to start putting our agents to work 24/7 without us needing to couple to Claude or another Big Three provider. One of our most recent applications is having it do security / pen testing 24/7. It seems to be doing good so far, and maybe soon we’ll begin auto-remediation. submitted by /u/dudemanji [link] [comments]
